test_log.expected: Root cause of DEF-04 to DEF-07: the best detection quality the flow features allow on unseen rows (analysis for the fix; thresholds chosen with the labels are upper bounds, not results).
test_log.actual: Trained on the UNSW-NB15 training file minus the cycle 1 hold-out (66,393 rows), scored on the hold-out (15,939 rows). Cycle 1 model B (Stacking, 15 features): ROC-AUC 0.9713, best recall at <= 8% false positives 0.879, best F1 0.880. A stronger single learner on the same 15 features: 0.9729 / 0.883 / 0.880; with derived ratios 0.9756 / 0.892 / 0.890; with per-flow TCP/HTTP fields 0.9736 / 0.886 / 0.884 - no 15-feature model can meet F1 and recall >= 90% with FPR <= 8%. With UNSW-NB15's connection counts 0.9943 / 0.982 / 0.956; the three destination-keyed counts (ct_dst_src_ltm, ct_dst_ltm, ct_srv_dst) alone 0.9932 / 0.978 / 0.951. Fix chosen: feature schema v2 with those three counts.

test_log.expected: Same-PC baseline for DEF-17: 90 s live capture of generated web traffic through the pre-fix path (one flow at a time, predict then predict_proba, cycle 1 model A); TC-11 measure p95 <= 500 ms.
test_log.actual: Wi-Fi capture with test-results/def_fixes_20261023/traffic_gen.py (bursts of HTTPS page loads; 94 requests): 5,016 packets, 0 dropped, 200 flows (101 rst, 5 fin, 94 idle timeout). FIN/RST flows n=106: p50 400.0 ms, p95 993.4 ms - reproduces DEF-17 (cycle 1: 388.9 / 895.6 ms). Model call p50 119.0 ms, p95 201.3 ms. 76.5% of these benign flows labelled Attack.

test_log.expected: Live capture of benign traffic is mostly labelled Normal (at most 8% false positives, the plan's target for unseen data). Master Test Plan section 8 limits cycle 1 accuracy claims to dataset and replay data; this check records how the model behaves on live flows.
test_log.actual: Benign generated web traffic on the Wi-Fi adapter. 10:53 (60 s, 95 flows): cycle 1 model A 73.7%, model B 82.1%, the 18-feature candidate (run 7) 96.8% labelled Attack; its connection counts look like UNSW normal traffic (1-4), but 77% of live flows carry TTL 128 (Windows), a value UNSW-NB15 never contains. 10:56 Random Forest with and without sttl/dttl on the same 60 s of flows: 80% vs 42% Attack, hold-out targets still met without them -> schema v2 drops sttl/dttl. 11:22 paired check, 208 flows: final model (run 8, 16 features) 82.2% Attack, run 7 97.1%; run 8 base models alone: Random Forest 33.2%, Gradient Boosting 23.1%, AdaBoost 16.8%, K-Nearest Neighbors 41.4%, Naive Bayes 89.9%.

test_log.expected: Whole independent set through the saved pipeline: accuracy, F1, attack recall >= 90%; FPR <= 8%; ROC-AUC >= 0.95 (plan 3.3).
test_log.actual: Retrained Stacking Ensemble (training run 8, local model 48, feature schema v2: 13 per-flow features + 3 destination connection counts; trained 2026-10-23 11:00-11:19 on the UNSW-NB15 training file minus the hold-out, 66,393 rows; SHA-256 1fd819c1...9f29; 10.7 MB compressed; published as deployment #2). Independent set = the 15,939 hold-out rows it never saw (the cycle 1 SYS-01.6 hold-out, rebuilt from research/dataset/holdout_ids.csv, same SHA-256 b76c8788...); 0 removed as seen. Accuracy 95.19%, F1 93.67%, recall 91.80%, FPR 2.66%, ROC-AUC 0.9890 - all met. Precision 95.61%, specificity 97.34%. Confusion: TN 9,505, FP 260, FN 506, TP 5,668. (Cycle 1 model A on the same hold-out: accuracy 81.69%, FPR 24.85%.)
